eras.name: Antiquity
eras.scope: Ancient societies before the first century AD; bronze and iron technologies where locally established

eras.name: Early Centuries AD
eras.scope: Roughly the first–fifth centuries AD; early imperial and late-antique contexts

eras.name: Middle Ages
eras.scope: Roughly AD 500–1500; later regional/period subdivisions can refine availability

eras.name: Early Modern
eras.scope: Roughly AD 1500–1800; expanding gunpowder warfare, maritime systems and organized military supply

eras.name: Contemporary
eras.scope: Used broadly in this library for industrial and modern military contexts, approximately the nineteenth century to the present

eras.name: Science Fiction
eras.scope: Fictional future or alternative technological contexts; availability determined by the setting

templates.name: Service melee weapon
templates.description: A purpose-built or issued weapon used through one or more physical contact modes
templates.activation_gates: Physical object; qualifying user; feasible action mode

templates.name: Human-powered projectile weapon
templates.description: Bow, sling, crossbow or comparable projectile-delivery equipment
templates.activation_gates: Compatible ammunition; physical capacity; supported line of effect

templates.name: Individual firearm family
templates.description: Region/date-supported individual firearm or setting-defined projectile arm
templates.activation_gates: Technology proof; functioning action; permitted user; stock separately tracked

templates.name: Speculative personal weapon
templates.description: Science-fiction personal armament without assumed energy mechanism
templates.activation_gates: Specific setting authorization; complete compatible effect/power model

templates.name: Service clothing and identification
templates.description: Uniform, insignia and occupational clothing used for identification and ordinary function
templates.activation_gates: Actual issued or owned clothing; does not confer rank or legal authority

templates.name: Military protective ensemble
templates.description: Assembled protective pieces with coverage, construction and protective channels
templates.activation_gates: Selected protection model; no summing full ratings for overlapping layers

templates.name: Hazard/environmental protective gear
templates.description: Respiratory or environmental protection for specified hazards
templates.activation_gates: Actual appropriate components/supply; not universal hazard immunity

templates.name: Powered protective suit or exoskeleton
templates.description: Powered worn system distinct from ordinary clothing and armor
templates.activation_gates: Setting technology; operator qualification; actual energy and maintenance

templates.name: Mechanical support/siege weapon
templates.description: Crew-operated mechanical artillery and siege systems
templates.activation_gates: Real crew, emplacement and suitable projectiles; no free coordinated shots

templates.name: Gunpowder artillery family
templates.description: Crew-served cannon, mortar or related support arm
templates.activation_gates: Historical/setting availability; separate munitions and service procedures

templates.name: Guided or remote support weapon
templates.description: System requiring target, control, guidance and effect configuration
templates.activation_gates: No omniscient targeting or unlimited ammunition; actual contact/lock

templates.name: Installed defensive/vehicle armament
templates.description: Weapon physically integrated into fortification, vessel or platform
templates.activation_gates: Parent asset configuration; component damage affects only linked functions

templates.name: Recoverable projectile expendable
templates.description: Arrows, bolts, stones, sling ammunition or equivalent launched objects
templates.activation_gates: Separate stock; fired/recovered only through actual location/condition change

templates.name: Propellant/charge input
templates.description: Powder or other propellant consumed by a compatible weapon/engine
templates.activation_gates: Actual finite stock; incompatible charges rejected; never abstract bullets

templates.name: Integrated firearm ammunition
templates.description: Cartridge or ammunition assembly including declared consumable parts
templates.activation_gates: Must match actual weapon; spent cases and recoverability per selected model

templates.name: Specialized expendable effect package
templates.description: Fuze, charge, missile, flare, smoke or other configured expendable
templates.activation_gates: Effect must be separately modeled; no generic explosion or casualty

templates.name: Personal camp and bivouac kit
templates.description: Bedding, shelter, cooking, lighting and hygiene kit for personnel
templates.activation_gates: Possession does not perform setup, preparation or personal care

templates.name: Load-carrying system
templates.description: Pack, harness and carrying structures for personal supplies
templates.activation_gates: Load uses real mass distribution; capacity not stock

templates.name: Portable repair and cleaning kit
templates.description: Occupation-specific supplies for maintaining issued field equipment
templates.activation_gates: Kit cannot create parts, competence or accepted equipment without work

templates.name: Field food and water package
templates.description: Prepared or carried food/water/support selection
templates.activation_gates: One source of stock; rations and feeding not charged twice

templates.name: Mounted and pack-animal equipment
templates.description: Tack, saddles, reins and burden attachment for living mounts
templates.activation_gates: Animal remains autonomous living actor with actual needs

templates.name: Cart/wagon/chariot carriage
templates.description: Wheeled conveyance requiring actual propulsion/animals and road access
templates.activation_gates: Real route, draft means, loading and transfer

templates.name: Motorized land transport
templates.description: Fuel/electrically powered military transport platform
templates.activation_gates: Vehicle operating profile; no fuel or instant travel granted

templates.name: Armored fighting/support land vehicle
templates.description: Land platform combining mobility, crew stations and protective/weapon subsystems
templates.activation_gates: Platform composition no independent duplicated component/munition stock

templates.name: Oared or sail-equipped military craft
templates.description: Era/region-dependent naval transport or combat vessel
templates.activation_gates: MAR module and actual qualified crew, not generic movement numbers

templates.name: Sailing ship and nautical equipment
templates.description: Sailing transport/warship rigging and navigation systems
templates.activation_gates: MAR module; physical ports/loading; separate weapons and supplies

templates.name: Powered surface or subsurface vessel
templates.description: Engine-powered naval platform with optional subsurface operation
templates.activation_gates: MAR/vessel profile including pressure/depth where applicable

templates.name: Speculative naval platform
templates.description: Setting-enabled advanced marine platform or ship
templates.activation_gates: No automatic FTL, invulnerability or artificial intelligence

templates.name: Lighter-than-air observation/transport craft
templates.description: Balloons or airships where era/region support them
templates.activation_gates: Flight model and operational envelope; no airspeed by era

templates.name: Powered atmospheric aircraft
templates.description: Fixed-wing or rotary-wing military aircraft
templates.activation_gates: Compatible aviation model; airframe not a generic vehicle speed

templates.name: Uncrewed aerial vehicle
templates.description: Uncrewed flight platform controlled locally or remotely
templates.activation_gates: Real channels, operator knowledge and power; no omniscience

templates.name: Spacecraft and orbital platform
templates.description: Technology-gated space transport, station or combat craft
templates.activation_gates: SPACE foundation; no inferred FTL, gravity or vacuum immunity

templates.name: Visual/sound signal system
templates.description: Standards, horns, flags and other line-of-sight signaling
templates.activation_gates: Actual observation/receipt; authority not transferred by flag alone

templates.name: Military records and courier equipment
templates.description: Dispatch cases, written orders, routes and administrative carriers
templates.activation_gates: Written order is information; copy possession not command execution

templates.name: Radio/telegraph/telephone equipment
templates.description: Era-enabled electrical communications
templates.activation_gates: Actual path and receivers; source messages separate from receipt

templates.name: Digital or speculative command network
templates.description: Connected communications and administration service
templates.activation_gates: No automatically global knowledge or unlimited AI agency

templates.name: Cartographic/route/navigation aids
templates.description: Map, chart, compass and route planning references
templates.activation_gates: Observation differs from interpretation; map is not route feasibility

templates.name: Optical observation equipment
templates.description: Binoculars, scopes or suitable era optics
templates.activation_gates: Better observation never creates invisible target data

templates.name: Electronic and remote sensor system
templates.description: Radar, sonar, thermal or other spectrum sensors
templates.activation_gates: Detect ≠ classify ≠ locate precisely; genre channel required

templates.name: Military surveying and intelligence tools
templates.description: Measuring and mapping equipment, sampling and reconnaissance record
templates.activation_gates: Separate observation, interpretation, report receipt and actual state

templates.name: Field engineering/entrenchment tools
templates.description: Tools and materials for fieldworks and obstacle alteration
templates.activation_gates: Actual work and material debit; no instant completed fortification

templates.name: Military workshop/arsenal support
templates.description: Repair/manufacturing work areas using appropriate machines
templates.activation_gates: Workshop/site/tool/service capacity one physical source of truth

templates.name: Power, water and field utility equipment
templates.description: Generation, water, cold chain, heating and sanitation support
templates.activation_gates: Service capacity not stock; no free energy or created water

templates.name: Fortifications and fixed defense sites
templates.description: Fieldworks, walls, prepared emplacements, shelters and fortresses
templates.activation_gates: Construction project accepted before functional site; no fortress HP

templates.name: First-aid equipment
templates.description: Dressing, splint, assessment and first-response supplies
templates.activation_gates: Possession does not treat; medicine follows selected MED model

templates.name: Casualty transport equipment
templates.description: Litters, stretchers, ambulance platforms and recovery transport
templates.activation_gates: Evacuation changes location only when executed; does not heal

templates.name: Military care facility
templates.description: Organized field/hospital care facility and service
templates.activation_gates: Beds ≠ staffed care capacity; no automatic recovery

templates.name: Speculative medical technology
templates.description: Fictional diagnostics, cybernetics or restorative intervention
templates.activation_gates: Setting enables intervention; no resurrection/instant healing by tag
